blocks.raw: # FAQs
blocks.text: FAQs

blocks.raw: **Q: What happens if I change the selection from the console or web interface?**
blocks.text: Q: What happens if I change the selection from the console or web interface?

blocks.raw: * The system automatically synchronises changes between the console and web interfaces.
blocks.text: The system automatically synchronises changes between the console and web interfaces.

blocks.raw: **Q: How are permissions handled?**
blocks.text: Q: How are permissions handled?

blocks.raw: * Permissions are managed via Intouch authorization sheet data, determining access to different modules and actions.
blocks.text: Permissions are managed via Intouch authorization sheet data, determining access to different modules and actions.

blocks.raw: **Q: Can permissions be set for viewing or executing queries?**
blocks.text: Q: Can permissions be set for viewing or executing queries?

blocks.raw: * Yes, permissions control whether a user can view queries, execute them, or both.
blocks.text: Yes, permissions control whether a user can view queries, execute them, or both.

blocks.raw: **Q: How are read and write queries managed?**
blocks.text: Q: How are read and write queries managed?

blocks.raw: * Functions are categorised as read or write. If a query contains at least one function from the write list, it is treated as a write query.
blocks.text: Functions are categorised as read or write. If a query contains at least one function from the write list, it is treated as a write query.

blocks.raw: **Q: Is there a limit to query results?**
blocks.text: Q: Is there a limit to query results?

blocks.raw: * Yes, a default limit of 10 is applied if the user does not explicitly set a limit.
blocks.text: Yes, a default limit of 10 is applied if the user does not explicitly set a limit.

blocks.raw: **Q: Can system-related queries be executed?**
blocks.text: Q: Can system-related queries be executed?

blocks.raw: * Yes, but only predefined functions are validated and executed.
blocks.text: Yes, but only predefined functions are validated and executed.

blocks.raw: **Q: Are query results saved?**
blocks.text: Q: Are query results saved?

blocks.raw: * No, only execution time and metadata are saved.
blocks.text: No, only execution time and metadata are saved.

blocks.raw: **Q: How is the approval process for write queries managed?**
blocks.text: Q: How is the approval process for write queries managed?

blocks.raw: * Write queries require approval through Hotswa. A reference ID is stored for tracking.
blocks.text: Write queries require approval through Hotswa. A reference ID is stored for tracking.

blocks.raw: **Q: Are there separate APIs for approval and creation?**
blocks.text: Q: Are there separate APIs for approval and creation?

blocks.raw: * Yes, there are console-specific APIs for approval and creation.
blocks.text: Yes, there are console-specific APIs for approval and creation.

blocks.raw: **Q: How are graphs generated?**
blocks.text: Q: How are graphs generated?

blocks.raw: * Chart IDs map to queries stored in the system. Data is fetched through APIs and plotted using charting libraries.
blocks.text: Chart IDs map to queries stored in the system. Data is fetched through APIs and plotted using charting libraries.

blocks.raw: **Q: Can users sign up from the dashboard?**
blocks.text: Q: Can users sign up from the dashboard?

blocks.raw: * Yes, user sign-up is supported.
blocks.text: Yes, user sign-up is supported.

blocks.raw: **Q: How does logout work?**
blocks.text: Q: How does logout work?

blocks.raw: * Logging out from the homepage redirects to Octa, invalidating the session. Implementing single logout ensures Octa sessions are invalidated.
blocks.text: Logging out from the homepage redirects to Octa, invalidating the session. Implementing single logout ensures Octa sessions are invalidated.
